tests.stimulus: Reset for the first three cycles before starting; reset again before transaction 8 to clear the sticky trigger; also interrupt decoding with reset after approximately 20 cycles and then resend. Drive on falling edges and observe outputs 1ns after assertion.
tests.expected: rst_n is an active-low asynchronous reset that clears dec_done, trigger_dec, total_bits_consumed, and all RGB outputs to zero; reset cancels in-flight transactions. dec_start is high for only one rising edge while idle; the three bitstreams, lengths, and block_num remain stable from acceptance to completion. Lengths are 0..1024, and all read indices must be within 1024 bits; each channel contains no more than 64 run/amplitude records (EOB also counts as one record), expanding to no more than 64 coefficients. Neither completion nor numerical values are guaranteed for over-capacity records, illegal codes, overlapping starts, or unstable streams. Reset may be asserted between clock edges; restart after deassertion. Complete tasks are serialized.
tests.checker: The same model/model.sv independently performs bitstream parsing, integer transforms, and timing prediction solely from input history. native_monitor retains four-state actual/expected 2ns after the edge; native_scoreboard compares done, trigger, and bits, and compares RGB when done; errors are reported as UVM_ERROR. tests.expected: Each of the three channels reads bit by bit starting from bs_*[0], with the first bit read serving as the most significant bit of the codeword. Use the fixed code table below to match the first complete code. The high 4 bits of symbol are run, and the low 4 bits are category. 0x00 is EOB; 0xf0 is 16 zeros. For category>0, continue reading category bits to form an 8-bit shift buffer v (retain the last 8 bits if more than 8 bits are read), and mask is the low 8 bits of (2^category-1); for category1..8, take v&mask if bit category-1 of v is 1; otherwise take the low 8 bits of (v&mask)-mask and interpret them as signed. category9/10 takes the else branch because the index exceeds 8 bits. The code table defines the symbol facts; the input length is allowed to end at a code boundary, and unfilled coefficients are 0.

tests.stimulus: After driving each transaction, up to a limit of 4000 cycles, the sequence independently parses the expected timing according to the model and simultaneously checks done; a timeout is recorded as UVM_ERROR and execution continues normally.
tests.expected: The acceptance edge is age0. For each channel, h is 2 times the total number of Huffman code bits read, plus category+2 for each record with category>0, plus 1 for EOB; add another 2 if the length is exhausted without EOB. r is the sum of run+1 for the records other than the zero-termination record before RLE stops, plus 2; if no record with run=0 and 8-bit amplitude=0 occurs, likewise add 2 when the records are exhausted. Let i=h+r+2; then completion occurs at age=max(iY+225,iCb+160,iCr+160)+66, the Y bit count updates at age=hY+1, and the trigger match updates at age=iY+1. This timing is guaranteed only for legal complete bitstreams within the transaction domain; asynchronous reset need not wait for completion.
